name: Kawakami-obaasan
source:
A nice grandmother who is in [url=/c67272]Mio[/url]'s care and meets [url=/c78567]Takuya[/url] while Mio makes him visit the hospital. She is currently in rehabilitation.

She finds Takuya very beautiful, and she makes Mio understand more than once that she has to do something to make him her own.
